full_judgment: 2. The Respondent No.1 as sole plaintiff instituted the suit for probate and letter of administration stating, inter alia, that the property covered by the will originally belonged to Sachindra Nath Kushari; Sachindra Nath Kushari was a relative of the plaintiff; The plaintiff took care and looked after Sachindra Nath Kushari and his wife; Being satisfied over the service rendered by the plaintiff Sachindra Nath Kusharimade a will on 15.10.1968 correspending to 29th Aswin, 1375 B.S. in respect of 1.36 acres land of plot No. 3389 and 07 acre land of plot No. 3403 of S.A. Khatian No. 1631 of mount Kuliadair under Bagerhat P.S. District — Bagerhat; After the death of the said testator the plaintiff, Misc. Case No. 97 of 1977 in the Court for 2nd Munsif Bagerhat for probate and letter of Administration upon that will; Since some lessees of the government in respect of the said properties appeared in the said suit by adding them as defendants the said court returned the petition of misc. case observing that it was beyond the 'jurisdiction of that court to decide the Misc. case; Consequently, the plaintiff filed instant suit with a prayer to grant of probate and letter of administration in respect of the said will before the District  Judge.
